notes.text:
V160 pair supervision substantially strengthens learned weak-mesh response,
with a visible noise cost. Mean response rises **81.75% raw /
95.73% EMA versus V143**, reaching **4.00% /
4.31% of exact constructed target amplitude**. Against the fresh
matched ordinary heads, response rises 84.62% / 94.77%.
This is a stronger learned-detail starting point than the retained V156–V159
heads. Existing periodic `detail` still has higher mean mesh response.

Actual blank RMS rises **3.25% / 4.69% versus V143**. Quiet-region
RMS rises **8.46–11.36%**, and all 32 quiet inputs worsen against
their matched ordinary endpoint. Each paired endpoint is worse than V143 on
31 of those 32 inputs. Native amplified crops show extra fine colored grain;
broad mottling persists. Full native512 noisy-flat RMS rises
**1.48–2.83%**. Raw is worse on 47/48 flat inputs and EMA on all 48.
Mean coarse block error can improve while total/spatial errors worsen.

The **ordinary new-data control** has a separate useful strength: native512
full flat RMS falls **0.42–0.53% versus V143**, with all
48 inputs improving in full and coarse error at both endpoints. Its quiet mean
instead rises 0.76–1.58%; 18/32 raw and 17/32 EMA inputs regress.
The largest quiet increase is 0.370174/0.387438 DN16. V158 retains stronger quiet
accuracy, V159 a smaller quiet cost, and V157 the larger standalone coarse gain.
The ordinary control changes the full data recipe versus those older studies.

In the standing real views, some existing partial cab-mesh strands gain a
little contrast, especially under the nearby profile. Crossings remain soft;
there is no convincing complete new fine lattice. Sky looks broadly smooth at
ordinary display, while exact flat/quiet controls expose the added texture.
Building edges and foliage remain soft. Bird, butterfly, grass and wood views
do not show convincing broad microtexture recovery. Natural-band gains are
small and mixed against V143, and ADC-photo error remains near parent level,
well behind V150's stronger ADC result. Independent ISO100 references are
qualitative comparisons, not exact GT.

Retain pair supervision and the paired data generator for further learned-detail
work, alongside the ordinary control's flat-field strength. The next problem is
to distinguish supported fine structure from noise more effectively while
preserving the measured response. The broader fine-detail/clean-field goal
remains active.

"""Bind reviewed summary claims to fixed endpoint metrics and actual viewing."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1'
scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');assert read(root/'native-viewing-v1.json')['sheets_viewed']==18
assert read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')['status']=='pass'

def value(method,kind,condition,field,cohort=None):
    return next(s[field] for s in scores['summary'] if (s['method'],s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'])==(method,kind,condition,cohort))

def change(method,base,kind,condition,field,cohort=None):
    return 100*(value(method,kind,condition,field,cohort)/value(base,kind,condition,field,cohort)-1)

methods=[f'paired-response-{e}-step1000' for e in ['raw','EMA']]
response=[value(m,'mesh',True,'template_gain') for m in methods]
response_change=[change(m,'parent','mesh',True,'template_gain') for m in methods]
matched_response=[change(m,f'ordinary-{e}-step1000','mesh',True,'template_gain') for m,e in zip(methods,['raw','EMA'],strict=True)]
blank=[change(m,'parent','mesh',True,'blank_error_RMS_DN16') for m in methods]
quiet=[change(m,'parent','mixed-quiet',p,'quiet_error_RMS_DN16') for m in methods for p in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']]
flat=[change(m,'parent','flat',p,'full_error_RMS_DN16','fresh-flat512') for m in methods for p in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']]
ordinary_flat=[change(f'ordinary-{e}-step1000','parent','flat',p,'full_error_RMS_DN16','fresh-flat512') for e in ['raw','EMA'] for p in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']]
ordinary_quiet=[change(f'ordinary-{e}-step1000','parent','mixed-quiet',p,'quiet_error_RMS_DN16') for e in ['raw','EMA'] for p in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']]
text=f'''V160 pair supervision substantially strengthens learned weak-mesh response,
with a visible noise cost. Mean response rises **{response_change[0]:.2f}% raw /
{response_change[1]:.2f}% EMA versus V143**, reaching **{100*response[0]:.2f}% /
{100*response[1]:.2f}% of exact constructed target amplitude**. Against the fresh
matched ordinary heads, response rises {matched_response[0]:.2f}% / {matched_response[1]:.2f}%.
This is a stronger learned-detail starting point than the retained V156–V159
heads. Existing periodic `detail` still has higher mean mesh response.

Actual blank RMS rises **{blank[0]:.2f}% / {blank[1]:.2f}% versus V143**. Quiet-region
RMS rises **{min(quiet):.2f}–{max(quiet):.2f}%**, and all 32 quiet inputs worsen against
their matched ordinary endpoint. Each paired endpoint is worse than V143 on
31 of those 32 inputs. Native amplified crops show extra fine colored grain;
broad mottling persists. Full native512 noisy-flat RMS rises
**{min(flat):.2f}–{max(flat):.2f}%**. Raw is worse on 47/48 flat inputs and EMA on all 48.
Mean coarse block error can improve while total/spatial errors worsen.

The **ordinary new-data control** has a separate useful strength: native512
full flat RMS falls **{-max(ordinary_flat):.2f}–{-min(ordinary_flat):.2f}% versus V143**, with all
48 inputs improving in full and coarse error at both endpoints. Its quiet mean
instead rises {min(ordinary_quiet):.2f}–{max(ordinary_quiet):.2f}%; 18/32 raw and 17/32 EMA inputs regress.
The largest quiet increase is 0.370174/0.387438 DN16. V158 retains stronger quiet
accuracy, V159 a smaller quiet cost, and V157 the larger standalone coarse gain.
The ordinary control changes the full data recipe versus those older studies.

In the standing real views, some existing partial cab-mesh strands gain a
little contrast, especially under the nearby profile. Crossings remain soft;
there is no convincing complete new fine lattice. Sky looks broadly smooth at
ordinary display, while exact flat/quiet controls expose the added texture.
Building edges and foliage remain soft. Bird, butterfly, grass and wood views
do not show convincing broad microtexture recovery. Natural-band gains are
small and mixed against V143, and ADC-photo error remains near parent level,
well behind V150's stronger ADC result. Independent ISO100 references are
qualitative comparisons, not exact GT.

Retain pair supervision and the paired data generator for further learned-detail
work, alongside the ordinary control's flat-field strength. The next problem is
to distinguish supported fine structure from noise more effectively while
preserving the measured response. The broader fine-detail/clean-field goal
remains active.
'''
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert not notes.exists();notes.write_text(text)
receipt=root/'human-quality-claims-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'reviewed-summary-bound-to-audited-metrics','scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    'viewing':ref(root/'native-viewing-v1.json'),'notes':dict(ref(notes),text=notes.read_text()),
    'derived':{'mesh_response_raw_EMA':response,'mesh_percent_vs_parent':response_change,
        'mesh_percent_vs_matched_ordinary':matched_response,'blank_percent_vs_parent':blank,
        'quiet_percent_vs_parent':quiet,'flat_percent_vs_parent':flat,
        'ordinary_flat_percent_vs_parent':ordinary_flat,'ordinary_quiet_percent_vs_parent':ordinary_quiet},
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Wrote reviewed quality notes and bound percentage claims')
